provider: Box for Nonprofits — donated Starter (10 perpetual licences)

free_tier.stated: Box Starter, free for nonprofits via TechSoup validation: 'Secure file collaboration, storage and native e-signatures for up to 10 users | 100 GB of storage | 2 GB file upload'. TechSoup confirms 'donations of up to 10 perpetual licenses for Box Starter Edition'. 100 GB shared per org.

egress.terms: No egress meter on Box downloads documented on the nonprofit page.

tooling: rclone backend 'box' (Tier 1, server-side copy); Box Content API.
chaining: 100 GB x one nonprofit org, with 10 perpetual seats sharing that 100 GB — not 100 GB per seat. Paid Business/Enterprise are 50% off, which is a discount not a grant, so this does not reach 500 GB free.
limits_note: per-object-cap 2 GB per upload. request-rate: Box API per-app throttling. retention: 'perpetual licenses' — no expiry, which is unusual and worth noting.
reliability_note: Stable and perpetual, but 100 GB aggregate is an order of magnitude. Only interesting as an egress-free front for a small hot set.
